additional_info.subject: ID0466860-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P8 170000972] CCS pistol loose CRM:03055000434
additional_info.body:
Hi Simen,
Following the client report and our checks and analysis, we can see that the error is related to RCD_FB1 or MCB_FC5 tripping. Please make sure to check carefully:
FB1 is a circuit breaker. If it trips, you need to rearm it on-site.
As for FC5, one of them must be rearmed. You need to identify which one; it is located at the bottom of the door.
Please provide me with the information if this ticket is only opened to report an activity or if any action from service is needed.
Thank you.
With best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
eMobility Technical Support Team

Hi, we don’t use the AC socket so that is why you see the error. Case is created for documentation purposes and claims.
